title: Live Update Policy
description: Which kinds of change a seller applies in place to a live creative, and how the creative serves while each is decided. A creative is live when its status is approved and it has at least one assignment on a package that is not canceled, whose flight has not ended, and whose media buy is not in a terminal state; a paused package still counts. A kind that is not listed is refused on a live creative with CREATIVE_LIVE_UPDATE_UNSUPPORTED, except under the capability declaration, which is a floor (see get_adcp_capabilities creative.live_updates).

in_place.description: Change kinds applied in place, each with its serving mode. At most one entry per change kind (sellers MUST NOT list a kind twice). An empty array means live creatives are immutable apart from name and tags.

on_rejection.description: Only with serving staged; defaults to keeps_prior. keeps_prior: if review rejects the staged update, the prior version keeps serving and the creative's status is unchanged. stops: the creative transitions to rejected and stops serving, with impairments on its media buys.
